newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani interbank market rates remain high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani interbank market rates remain high.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank money market rates remained high on Monday on a shortage of funds, dealers said.
"Interbank overnight rates stayed pegged to the central bank's discount rate," one dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank in Karachi said.
Bids and offers remained at 20 percent throughout the day and most trades were closed at this level, he said.
However, players who could not avail the central bank discount window facility had to pay premium ranging from 100 to 200 basis points, the dealer said.
